items.title: Bound replay identity
items.recommendation: Bind replay IDs to canonical arguments, backend session, project, and target. Reusing an operation ID for a different edit must produce a conflict, not an old success receipt.
items.boundary: Changed arguments, project, sequence or session conflict; bounded hashed reservations and documented UXP cryptographic session identities.

items.title: Consumed unknown receipts
items.recommendation: Retain a consumed/unknown operation receipt after an error following host dispatch. Avoid accidentally repeating a partially applied edit.
items.boundary: Durable hashed tombstones survive panel reload; unexpected post-dispatch errors are never retry permission. Capacity is 4,096 IDs / 1 MiB; full, corrupt or unwritable storage refuses new writes. Reviewed acknowledgement does not erase consumed IDs.

items.title: Explicit MCP hints
items.recommendation: Register explicit per-tool MCP annotations and check them against authority and action semantics. Clients should receive accurate edit/destructive hints.
items.boundary: Definition annotations win; mixed actions remain conservative and authority is independently enforced.

items.title: Exact invocation preflight
items.recommendation: Add an invocation-aware `can_execute` preflight: tool + exact targets → enabled, reasons, required state, and evidence age. Reduce failed calls and guessed prerequisites.
items.boundary: can_execute validates schema, authority, files and bounded CEP targets; unavailable UXP action predicates remain unknown.

items.title: Common mutation receipts
items.recommendation: Normalize mutation receipts across CEP, UXP, AE, local artifacts, and orchestrators. Give clients one reliable way to understand partial work.
items.boundary: Versioned dispatch/outcome/boundary/partial-step/output evidence; existing detailed handler outcomes preserved.

items.title: Cooperating host ownership
items.recommendation: Coordinate cooperating MCP processes and multi-command workflows through one host-owner lease. Prevent read/write interleaving across separate clients.
items.boundary: Cross-process lease spans protected workflows for shared private bridge directory. Premiere UI and unrelated extensions are outside the lease.

items.title: Expected host targets
items.recommendation: Standardize project/sequence/clip identity and expected-state envelopes for legacy setters as well as new workflows. Prevent active-project or track-index surprises.
items.boundary: expected_cep_target guards project document, sequence, source, clip exact ticks and effect parameter before generated body; no UXP fallback.

items.title: Reviewed recovery gate
items.recommendation: Put targets with an unknown mutation outcome into a recovery-required state. Surface a clear pending-operation status instead of letting later tools build on uncertain state.
items.boundary: Unknown outcomes block dependent writes until exact latest ledger/host revision is reviewed and acknowledged. Consumed IDs remain consumed.

items.title: Schema/receipt negotiation
items.recommendation: Negotiate command/schema and receipt versions in addition to transport protocol and host capabilities. Detect an old panel paired with a new server before editing.
items.boundary: UXP writes require matching command schema/receipt versions and durable hashed tombstone storage; older unversioned panels allow reads only. CEP heartbeat/doctor reports its independent compatibility boundary, including legacy transport. Host API support is probed separately.

items.title: Strict nested validation
items.recommendation: Standardize named errors and strict nested/cross-field argument validation. Make invalid units and contradictory fields diagnosable before host dispatch.
items.boundary: Named unknown-field and nonfinite/depth/breadth errors; intentionally open metadata maps preserved. Existing typed cross-field validation retained.

items.title: Lossless tick contract
items.recommendation: Preserve decimal tick strings end to end; use BigInt and rational rates in Node planning. Keep seconds as a convenience view.
items.boundary: BigInt decimal ticks stay lossless in canonical planning; legacy convenience seconds are accepted only when safe for selected workflows.

items.title: Rational rates/timecode
items.recommendation: Centralize frame-grid, rational-frame-rate, drop-frame timecode, and exclusive-end conversions. Remove subtly different conversions between tools.
items.boundary: Signed frame/sample/time conversion, exclusive ends and 29.97/59.94 drop-frame minute rules; host code remains ES3.

items.title: Canonical snapshots
items.recommendation: Define one versioned, bounded project/sequence snapshot format with source ranges, links, locks, targeting, transitions, effects, markers, and timing domains.
items.boundary: Version, session/project/sequence, exact ranges, descriptors, completeness and revision. Missing CEP links/locks/effects/transitions/markers remain unknown.

items.title: Expected-edit algebra
items.recommendation: Add a pure expected-edit model that predicts an affected-state diff before applying supported operations. Catch collateral edits early.
items.boundary: Pure insert/overwrite/trim/split/move/remove/ripple/enable subset predicts exact diffs; synthetic additions never authorize host mutation.

items.title: Extended typed compound plans
items.recommendation: Expand compound plans beyond insert/remove to supported trim, split, move, enable, effect, and keyframe operations. Reduce fragile client-side sequences.
items.boundary: Single-use previews compose supported trim/split/move/enable/effect/keyframe handlers with exact target guards; sequential partial work is explicit.

items.title: Source/neighbor constraints
items.recommendation: Share source-handle and neighbor preflight across trims, transitions, duplicate, slide, slip, and nesting. Avoid shortened transitions and destroyed neighboring material.
items.boundary: Shared source-handle/neighbor preflight in the canonical model and compound routes complements existing physical-duration checks in legacy trim/slide/slip tools. Unknown mappings refuse.

items.title: Explicit ripple scope
items.recommendation: Reuse one documented sync-lock/targeting/ripple scope model. Give clients an exact list of tracks and clips that will move.
items.boundary: Model names every participating track/clip and requires known locks/sync state. Existing native ripple route remains separately guarded.

items.title: A/V continuity verification
items.recommendation: Verify linked A/V partners and source continuity as shared postconditions, including split and reverse boundaries. Catch tiny duplicate pieces or missing sound.
items.boundary: Exact links/source/ranges/speed/reverse/nesting and unaffected-neighbor comparison; structural proof does not establish audible synchronization.

items.title: Effect descriptor identity
items.recommendation: Make effect/parameter discovery the shared descriptor contract: stable match identity where available, display name, type, units, animation state, and verified writability.
items.boundary: Stable match and exact indexed parameter identity, type/units/writability/animation evidence. Compound writes refuse built-ins and unknown descriptors.

items.title: Keyframe timing domains
items.recommendation: Carry explicit source, clip-relative, and sequence time domains through keyframe plans and receipts. Extend existing time-base protections to retiming and nested clips.
items.boundary: Explicit source/relative/sequence tick mappings for supported forward 1x clips. Nonlinear retiming/nesting refuse without a measured adapter.

items.title: Progress and job status
items.recommendation: Wire existing host-job/event information into MCP progress notifications and a unified job status contract. Keep long work observable and inspection responsive.
items.boundary: Bounded MCP progress, local/native job observation and exact tracked-receipt identity. Missing receipts never mean completion.

items.title: Owned local cancellation
items.recommendation: Define cancellation separately for local processes, not-yet-dispatched work, and accepted native host jobs. Prevent misleading “cancelled” receipts.
items.boundary: Undispatched jobs and local subprocesses use AbortSignal; stopped waits never claim accepted native work was cancelled.

items.title: Export lineage receipts
items.recommendation: Correlate each export with its exact job, project/sequence/range, preset, destination, and observed artifact. Avoid treating unrelated encoder events as our completion.
items.boundary: Exact bounded project/sequence/item/range/preset/destination lineage is SHA-256 bound in Node. Pinned EncoderManager returns Boolean; generic terminal events normalize to unknown/reconciliation-required, with no completion claim. nativeJobId is absent unless actually supplied.

items.title: Guarded delivery orchestration
items.recommendation: Add a guarded export-and-verify workflow that composes preflight, dispatch, wait where supported, file validation, ffprobe conformance, and optional decoded QC.
items.boundary: Saved exact CEP project/sequence guard, new output, validated preset/contract, direct render, checksum/conformance and optional decoded QC. Visual rendering remains a separate check.

items.title: Decoded temporal harness
items.recommendation: Build a temporal render validation harness for effects, transitions, speed, and interpolation. Prove the produced video, not just a stored parameter or QE still.
items.boundary: Actual multi-frame video decoding, sampled RGB/ROI and optional decoded PCM RMS against a measured oracle. A generated dissolve passes and wrong expectations fail.

items.title: Checked capture restoration
items.recommendation: Make preview capture restore state with checked cleanup and explicit evidence if restoration fails. Avoid moving the editor's playhead or selection unnoticed.
items.boundary: Temporary-mark ownership and restore readback propagate recovery-required uncertainty; concurrent UI changes are not overwritten silently.

items.title: Owned image evidence
items.recommendation: Standardize image responses with target sequence, requested/actual time, capture method, resolution, freshness, and unique request-owned files. Make visual evidence understandable.
items.boundary: UUID capture paths, exact target/time evidence/method/resolution, PNG header and stable regular-file checks; no arbitrary panel path read/unlink.

items.title: Before/after review artifacts
items.recommendation: Combine existing clip/marker review frames into bounded contact sheets and short before/after review clips at risky edits. Reduce visual review effort.
items.boundary: Bounded contact sheets plus optional create-only <=30-second MP4 excerpts, hashes and decoded frame counts. Comparison remains human/explicit-oracle work.

items.title: Rendered output scopes
items.recommendation: Analyze actual exported output for grade/scopes and color-management QC, with declared transfer/range/primaries and HDR policy. Avoid grading from source-only proxies.
items.boundary: Actual local output RGB sampling and ffprobe encoded color metadata, caller declarations kept separate. RGB proxy does not establish HDR/legal-range correctness.

items.title: Content/revision analysis cache
items.recommendation: Cache expensive analysis by media identity, source/timeline revision, tool version, and options. Invalidate only affected evidence.
items.boundary: Opt-in six allowlisted read analyses keyed by canonical source identity, content hash, options, revision and tool version; bounded LRU, concurrent insertion accounting, source stability checks and clone isolation.

items.title: Synchronization proposal
items.recommendation: Add a local audio/timecode/marker synchronization planner with confidence and ambiguous-match reporting. Help users prepare multicamera sessions safely.
items.boundary: Bounded PCM correlation or measured timecode/marker anchors return confidence and ambiguous alternatives; never automatically shifts native media.

items.title: Stacked camera executor
items.recommendation: Add a reviewed executor for the existing stacked-camera angle plan, with master-audio preservation and an exact expected diff.
items.boundary: Reviewed ordinary pre-razored tracks are cloned, video enabled states checked, master-audio structural ranges preserved. Native multicam switching is unsupported.

items.title: Transcript readiness composition
items.recommendation: Compose native transcription start → readiness → transcript inspection → revision-bound planning. Avoid repeated transcription dispatch and premature editing.
items.boundary: Existing native has/start/readiness/segment routes, persistent start claims and revision-bound evidence; uncertain starts are never blindly resent.

items.title: Repeated word placement
items.recommendation: Extend transcript-to-timeline mapping through repeated source placements and supported nesting/retiming. Keep unsupported mappings explicitly review-only.
items.boundary: Distinct occurrence IDs across repeated forward 1x placements with exact ticks; nested/nonlinear retime mappings remain unsupported.

items.title: Caption render evidence contract
items.recommendation: Validate rendered captions/titles for clipping, glyph coverage, line breaks, bidirectional text, and platform safe zones. Close the gap between artifact timing and readable output.
items.boundary: Checks caller-measured rendered bounds, glyphs, line breaks, bidi and safe zones with SHA-256 provenance. No OCR or unmeasured visual success claim.

items.title: Deterministic music remix plan
items.recommendation: Offer a deterministic music-remix planning workflow: measured beat grid, protected intro/outro, proposed joins, optional crossfades.
items.boundary: Measured beat-grid shortening, protected intro/outro and explicit proposed joins/crossfades. No DSP renderer or native Adobe Remix API claim.

items.title: Reviewed scene application
items.recommendation: Connect scene-change candidates to a reviewed marker/subclip/bin workflow with false-positive review. Make existing scene detection useful end to end.
items.boundary: Approved candidates, exact saved project/source and physical bounds; actual source markers/subclips/bin composition. Audio inclusion requested, decoded audio preservation remains unverified.

items.title: Source/proxy provenance
items.recommendation: Carry source/proxy provenance through analysis, planning, and delivery checks. Avoid assuming a proxy represents the full-resolution camera original.
items.boundary: Content/revision/provider identity travels in bounded planning evidence; delivery cannot assume proxy evidence represents the original.

items.title: Project handoff manifest
items.recommendation: Produce a consolidated-project handoff manifest with expected/observed dependencies, byte inventory completeness, missing media, and source identity.
items.boundary: Expected/observed dependencies and contained-file byte inventory, missing/unresolved/truncated states. Completeness needs explicit project dependency evidence.

items.title: Persistent workflow checkpoints
items.recommendation: Join existing checkpoints/backups/recovery inspection to operation receipts and versioned workflow state. Make interrupted sessions reviewable on restart.
items.boundary: Private bounded versioned receipt/state references survive restart; inspection never restores or replays uncertain host edits.

items.title: Honest native OTIO capability
items.recommendation: Reconcile OTIO capability reporting and qualify interchange export receipts. Users should see the actual runtime boundary and artifact evidence.
items.boundary: Documented UXP OTIO and XML probes are independent; Boolean export acceptance is committed_unverified. Optional fresh bounded artifact readback needs filesystem authority.

items.title: Bounded offline OTIO
items.recommendation: Add bounded OTIO inspection and snapshot conversion around the existing native exporter. Support offline timeline planning without guessing undocumented `.prproj` internals.
items.boundary: Exact rational-time inspection and supported snapshot conversion. Effects/nests/metadata/schema loss is refused or explicitly reported; no prproj parser.

items.title: Feature-level loss reports
items.recommendation: Emit per-feature interchange loss reports for FCP7 XML, FCPXML, OTIO, EDL, AAF, and OMF. Warn precisely about nests, effects, links, retiming, captions, and metadata loss.
items.boundary: OTIO, FCP7 xmeml, modern FCPXML, EDL, AAF and OMF support/loss/unknown matrix; opaque native formats remain unknown.

items.title: Canonical interchange fixtures
items.recommendation: Add canonical interchange round-trip fixtures with exact timing and explicit loss expectations. Catch schema changes before turnover.
items.boundary: Retained seeded rational-rate parse/serialize/parse fixtures and exact supported snapshot projection; destination-editor/native fidelity remains a host gate.

items.title: Audio-post turnover contract
items.recommendation: Build an audio-post turnover workflow around existing AAF/OMF exporters: handle ranges, channel mapping, sample rate, gain automation, media manifest, and reference picture.
items.boundary: Existing AAF/OMF native routes with explicit handles/range/channel/rate/gain/media/reference-picture plan and post-export checks. No new opaque serializer.

items.title: Spreadsheet-safe review markers
items.recommendation: Export review markers as bounded CSV and JSON with IDs, comments, color, duration, rational rate, tick/timecode columns, and spreadsheet-safe text.
items.boundary: Create-only bounded CSV/JSON with IDs/comments/colors/rational rate/exact ticks/drop-frame display and escaped multiline/formula text.

items.title: Facility metadata adapter
items.recommendation: Add an ALE or facility metadata table intake/export adapter using existing bounded field-level metadata tools. Improve assistant-editor handoffs.
items.boundary: Bounded ALE intake/export reports duplicates/missing sources/unsupported fields; proposals route separately through existing named-field metadata readback.

items.title: Retained property seeds
items.recommendation: Add randomized/property-based edit-model tests with retained failing seeds. Broaden assurance beyond individual mocked examples.
items.boundary: Retained seeds cover 480 individual edits and 240 eight-operation sequences, plus exact-time properties across rational rates. Unsupported mappings/refusals and collateral-state checks are explicit.

items.title: Licensed-host fixture matrix
items.recommendation: Turn licensed-host sweep templates into a repeatable fixture workflow matrix with actual before/after, Undo/reopen, playback, and exported-artifact evidence.
items.boundary: Repeatable host reports require pinned environment/capabilities and hashed before/after, Undo/reopen, playback and export evidence. All licensed-host cells remain not_run.

items.title: Transport fault injection
items.recommendation: Expand transport fault injection for disconnects, duplicate requests, changed arguments, late replies, panel reloads, job disappearance, and concurrency.
items.boundary: Disconnects/late/wrong/duplicate replies, changed arguments, panel reload, cache expiry, recovery and independent-process concurrency are covered without resend.

items.title: Dependency boundary gate
items.recommendation: Enforce dependency boundaries between pure planning, security/schema, bridge adapters, and tool orchestration. Keep local-only helpers auditable as local-only.
items.boundary: npm run check:layers gates pure planning/security dependencies; two existing parser reuse edges are explicit exceptions, not blanket permissions.

items.title: Bounded performance evidence
items.recommendation: Expose bounded local performance diagnostics: queue wait, host wait, dispatch, readback, payload size, analysis-cache hit, and artifact-validation cost. Optimize measured bottlenecks.
items.boundary: Content-free bounded numeric stage medians/p95/payload/cache counts plus generated 100/1,000/10,000-clip benchmark. Unmeasured stages remain null; no host latency claim.
